characters.name: Yael
characters.description: Girl about 5 years old, small, light olive skin, rosy cheeks, shoulder-length wavy brown hair loose for bedtime, big hazel eyes, navy-blue long-sleeved pajamas with little yellow stars; signature item: a soft brown teddy bear with a light-blue ribbon around its neck.

characters.name: Ima
characters.description: Yael's mother, early 30s, slim, light olive skin, warm brown eyes, her hair fully tucked under a soft teal headscarf tied at the back, long-sleeved cream knit sweater and a long grey skirt, a thin gold ring; signature item: the teal headscarf.

characters.name: Moshe
characters.description: Very old man of about 120, slender, long flowing white beard and white hair, kind tired brown eyes, warm olive skin, simple light cream linen robe with a sand-colored sash, plain undyed head cloth, sandals, holds a tall plain wooden shepherd's staff. No glow or rays around his head.

cover.prompt: Cozy children's bedroom at night: Yael sits up in bed holding her teddy bear, her right hand gently covering her eyes, while Ima sits on the edge of the bed smiling tenderly beside her. A small yellow lamp glows, stars twinkle through the window over Jerusalem-stone rooftops, and a silver mezuzah is clearly visible on the doorpost. Soft warm light, calm and loving.

pages.prompt: Night has fallen over an Israeli apartment; through the window, balconies and stars. Yael in her star pajamas climbs happily into her warm bed, toothbrush just put away, teddy bear tucked under her arm. A bookshelf with holy books, a small night lamp, and a silver mezuzah on the door frame. Wide shot of the cozy room, gentle blue night outside and golden light inside.

Ima sits down on the edge of the bed and leans toward Yael with a soft questioning smile. Yael, tucked under her blanket with her teddy, places her right hand over her eyes, ready and serious. Medium shot at bed level, warm lamp light on their faces, the doorway with its mezuzah softly visible behind.

Quiet sacred moment: Yael and Ima side by side, both covering their eyes with their right hands, lips softly moving together. The room is hushed and dim, the small lamp casting a warm soft glow across the blanket. Close, symmetrical framing of the two faces, peaceful and focused.

Playful close-up: Yael peeks out between two spread fingers with one big curious hazel eye, a little mischievous smile. Ima, still beside her, smiles back gently and answers with a finger raised as she explains. Warm lamplight, teddy bear peeking from under the blanket.

Yael lies in bed looking up with wonder as Ima tells the story. Above the bed, in a soft dreamy watercolor cloud like a bedtime vision, old Moshe stands on a rock in the desert, arms open, speaking to a great crowd of families among tents. The vision is pale and golden, the bedroom below warm and clear.

Yael squeezes her teddy bear in a huge tight hug with eyes scrunched shut and a big smile, showing love with all her heart. Ima laughs, hand on her chest, delighted. Medium shot, warm cozy colors, a joyful tender moment.

Ima speaks softly while Yael sits up and points at her with excitement, mouth open in recognition. Through the window, a split sky: on one side a soft sunrise glow, on the other a crescent moon and stars, showing morning and night. Medium shot, gentle and warm.

View from the bed toward the bedroom door: a slim silver mezuzah case fixed slanted on the right doorpost, plain and shiny, catching the lamp light, with nothing written visible. In the foreground, Yael leans out of bed pointing at it curiously, and Ima kneels by the doorway touching the mezuzah gently with her fingertips.

Ima bends over and kisses Yael on the forehead as Yael looks thoughtfully toward the door. The mezuzah on the doorpost glows softly in the warm light, like a quiet guardian of the room. Tender close-medium shot, soft shadows, feeling of safety.

Ima stands by the door with her hand on the light switch, the big ceiling light now off. Only the small bedside lamp remains, casting a round pool of soft yellow light over Yael tucked in bed. The rest of the room is in gentle blue shadow, stars bright in the window. Wide, calm composition.

Close-up of Yael lying on her pillow with eyes closed, whispering softly, teddy bear in her arms, a peaceful smile. The yellow lamp light touches her cheek, and a gentle warm glow seems to fill the room around her, as if her heart is full. Very calm, quiet, dreamy.

Goodnight scene: a wide, peaceful view of the bedroom at night, Yael fast asleep with her teddy, the little lamp dimmed, the mezuzah on the doorpost catching a sliver of light from the hallway. Through the window, the lights of the city and a sky full of stars. Deep blue and soft gold, inviting every child to sleep.
